(1) This order may be called the Newsprint Control (Amendment) Order, 2016. (2) It shall come into force on the date of its publication in the official Gazette. 2. In the Newsprint Control Order, 2004, in the Schedule, in item 4 relating to the name of the mill and location, after S.No. 122, and the entries relating thereto, the following serial number and entries shall be added, namely :— ‘‘123. M/s. Katyayini Paper Mills Pvt. Limited, Kudaiawala, Kashipur,, Udham Singh Nagar-244713, Uttarakhand’’ [F. No. 4(3)2015-Paper] SHAILENDRA SINGH, Jt. Secy. Note : The principal order was published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) vide number S.O. 1105 (E), dated the 11th October, 2004 and lastly amended vide number S.O. 447(E), dated the 9th February, 2016.
